summary: Moxxie Ventures says on its homepage that it invests early and works alongside founders building something meaningful and enduring, with a team of networked engineers, marketers, product managers, founders and sales leaders. The site lists a broad portfolio spanning health operations, climate, fintech, legal AI and logistics, and publishes a hello email. Stage definition, check size, sector mandate, geography and a street address are not stated, so a match on those criteria cannot be confirmed from the website.

investmentEvidence.fact: Listed on the homepage as a portfolio company building direct air capture. Round and date are not stated.
